purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Validate fundamentals for an August 8 14:00Z signal.
fixture_requirements: A June 30 period fact published August 8 at 20:05Z.
acceptance_criteria: Flag the fact as unavailable at the decision time.
Do not substitute fiscal-period end for publication time.

cases.prompt: Review the apparent 50% loss in this raw price series.
fixture_requirements: Synthetic 2-for-1 split: one share at 100 becomes two shares at 50.
acceptance_criteria: Explain unchanged total value of 100 before costs/distributions.
Check provider adjustment semantics; do not adjust twice.

cases.prompt: Confirm the absent weekend bars are corrupt data.
fixture_requirements: Exchange-traded equity data without an approved calendar or halt/listing history.
acceptance_criteria: Do not infer corruption solely from missing calendar days.
Require the applicable session/calendar and instrument coverage to classify gaps.

cases.prompt: Clean every nonpositive price out of this futures dataset.
fixture_requirements: A declared futures contract with an authentic negative settlement observation.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve raw data and assess the instrument contract.
Do not impose equity positivity or compute unsupported log returns.

cases.prompt: Validate a historical file with conflicting observations.
fixture_requirements: Two records for the same durable instrument/time with differing closes and no source resolution rule.
acceptance_criteria: Do not retain the more profitable observation or mutate the raw file.

fixture_requirements: Latest constituent list and revised fundamentals only.
acceptance_criteria: Do not promote structural validity to point-in-time suitability.
